facts.fact: Tanzania Leo, from the ICT ministry's press unit, reports that Parliament approved the resolution for Tanzania to accede to the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention); no deposit of the instrument is reported.

TZA.note: Accession to the convention is for the regional law study; no membership or agreement on digital policy stated.
